title: Editor crash when selecting a node
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.beta6.official [d5ad0556a]

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta6 - Ubuntu 25.04 25.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (nvidia; 575.64.03) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700G with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 61.09 GiB memory

### Issue description

On a current project, selecting a specific node crashed the editor.

Its a very weird behavior. The Label itself doesnt have anything unique about it
Checking the scene using a text editor, we can see that the scene only has a LabelSetting resource attached to it.

```
[node name="Label" type="Label" parent="frame/PanelContainer"]
layout_mode = 2
size_flags_vertical = 1
text = "Title"
label_settings = SubResource("LabelSettings_yqa33")
horizontal_alignment = 1
vertical_alignment = 1
```
```
[sub_resource type="LabelSettings" id="LabelSettings_yqa33"]
font = ExtResource("2_2pu8v")
```
```
[ext_resource type="FontFile" uid="uid://bmt3s8i84e3xl" path="res://barkley2/resources/fonts/fn1.tres" id="2_2pu8v"]
```
[o_mg_document.tscn.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21946359/o_mg_document.tscn.tar.gz)

I was able to workaround this issue by removing the LabelSettings resource manually. Is this something I can avoid in the future?

### Steps to reproduce

Unknown.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Cannot replicate the issue on a standalone project.
